The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a shale as the anchor of the cost.
